name: agent-office-cats
description: Cat Office: a thin row per agent with an animated pixel cat (or robot, or spacefarer) for its role, what it is doing and its own little bar, under a pixel-office header, plus a progress bar above the prompt

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Palette for the header and the progress bar

skin.title: Figures
skin.description: office-cats: the user's own round pixel cats, one per role (orange tabby, blue-grey, golden, pink calico, siamese, cream white, pink-and-white). robots: the pixel robots. space-crew: a different spacefarer per role.

backdrop.title: Figure backdrop in the terminal
backdrop.description: skin: the figures' own backdrop (an office wall for the cats, beige for robots, deep space for the crew). terminal: your terminal's own background.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How often the terminal repaints the progress bar (4-30). Figures step at their own pace.

autoOpenPane.title: Open the pane on start
autoOpenPane.description: Open the Cat Office by itself when the session starts (needs a wide terminal); /office always opens it

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: A small note in the app when Claude finishes, stops on an error, or a helper has an error

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Desktop notification after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a desktop notification when Claude finishes or stops on an error after working at least this long; 0 turns it off
